title: In the Name of Fairness: Assessing the Bias in Clinical Record De-identification

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the recall performance of named entity recognition and de-identification systems on clinical notes populated with predominantly male versus female names.
Evaluating de-identification performance disparities by inserting names strongly associated with White, Black, Asian, and Hispanic populations into clinical templates.
Measuring the recall equality difference of de-identification tools when extracting names of top, medium, and bottom popularity based on historical frequency records.
Assessing performance gaps in de-identification systems by evaluating names that were most popular in different decades (2000s, 1970s, and 1940s), acting as a proxy for patient age.
